scope.materialDescription: The topics found across everything in this knowledge base. Pick a topic to include all of it, or open it to choose subtopics. Leave everything unticked to draw from the whole knowledge base.
scope.noTopicMap: No topic map yet. It is built automatically once a document finishes processing.
scope.planHint: You will see the full plan and can change it before any question is written.

generating.hint: This usually takes a few minutes. You can leave this page — the paper keeps generating and will be waiting in your question bank drafts.

review.heading: Review and generate
review.description: Check the configuration, then generate. The planner spreads your question mix across the selected material; you can adjust that plan before anything is written.
review.generateHint: Generate plans the sections and writes every question in one go. Adjust plan first shows the section plan for editing before anything is written.
review.noMixHint: No question types configured — the planner will choose a mix.

syllabus.heading: Configure syllabus and weightage
syllabus.description: Tick the chapters, topics or subtopics the paper should cover. Leave everything unticked to draw from the whole book. Weightage is optional — what you leave blank, the planner balances.
syllabus.weightageHint: Set a % weightage on a ticked chapter to steer how many questions it gets. Totals need not add up to 100.

types.heading: Configure question types and marks
types.description: Tick the kinds of questions you want, then set how many and how many marks each. The totals in the header are exactly what the paper will carry.

details.heading: Configure test details
details.description: Name the paper, set its duration and difficulty, and the class and language the questions are written for.

syllabusNote: This is the official syllabus, not a textbook: the paper stays inside the listed units, and questions are set from the standard curriculum rather than cited to a page.
